Accenture Federal Services is a technology company serving US federal government organizations across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health missions. The Backend Application Engineer will design, build, test, maintain, and modernize enterprise application services, APIs, integrations, and data-access layers while collaborating with cross-functional teams and progressively taking ownership of complex engineering work.

Responsibilities
Design, build, test, and maintain enterprise application services, APIs, business logic, data-access layers, and integrations
Develop solutions using languages and frameworks appropriate to the problem, including Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or comparable technologies
Integrate applications with databases, messaging platforms, external services, legacy systems, cloud services, and enterprise platforms
Modernize legacy application components and help decompose tightly coupled systems into maintainable services and reusable capabilities
Write automated unit, integration, and API tests and participate in code reviews, CI/CD, debugging, release support, and production issue resolution
Apply secure coding, API design, error handling, logging, observability, performance, and data-integrity practices throughout development
Use AFS-approved AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and analysis while validating outputs
Partner with Product Managers, Digital Experience Engineers, Quality Engineers, Cloud Platform Engineers, architects, security teams, and client stakeholders
As your experience grows, lead complex services or application areas, establish technical patterns, mentor engineers, and shape modernization and architecture decisions

Required
Professional experience in back-end, application, software, API, or integration engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Hands-on development experience in at least one modern enterprise language such as Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language
Experience building or consuming REST APIs, services, business logic, or enterprise application integrations
Experience with relational or NoSQL databases and common data-access concepts
Experience leveraging code assist technologies while developing applications (e.g., Gemini Code Assist, GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
Understanding of automated testing, source control, code review, debugging, CI/CD, and Agile software delivery
For candidates with deeper experience, demonstrated ability to lead complex application work, mentor others, define engineering patterns, and make sound tradeoff decisions across teams
U.S. Citizenship required
Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States
Preferred
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
Experience with Spring/Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js, FastAPI/Django/Flask, Go frameworks, or comparable application frameworks
Experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, messaging technologies, API gateways, or enterprise integration patterns
Experience with AWS, Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, or cloud-native application development
Experience with application modernization, legacy integration, data migration, performance engineering, or secure software development
Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, communicate technical issues clearly, and take increasing ownership of services or application workstreams
Previous federal consulting, government, or mission-oriented delivery experience
Benefits
A collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.
Hybrid, remote, or client-site work environment as program needs require.
